chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Becoming a traveling single: Michael's Pub
summary: He began working as a single with house groups after Michael's Pub contacted him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: What -- what brought you to your decision that you were not going to go on with a group, but you'd travel as a single? You just came to realize how much simpler it was?

No, I think when they were opening Michael's Pub, I'll tell you the story, they were opening Michael's Pub, Bourgeois recommended me they made contact, I knew Charlie Bushwa director or something, cause I -- been working with George before, I went into that two-year job and Tropicana in Vegas. So, I'd been off and so they contacted me about coming here, but they were delayed so when I went up to see Mark in Vegas, during the summer and they called me I was already booked in Vegas. I was working so I couldn't do it.
So after that they wanted me, said "Well, you come in, we'll get a group here." I said, "That's fine."
That's fine I'd like to do that.
Cause you knew whoever they got would be people that --
So that's the way it started. I did that and the next thing you know I was working someplace else.
And I just started doing it that way.
It's so much simpler, that's right.
Now it's a big thing around.
